text: A hectic rush began when a tangled queue was first spotted by a new handler and the waiting line at the Companion Animal Travel Desk started to slow near the pet check-in lanes. Title: Tangled Queue Incident at Aurelia Skyways. Travelers with carriers gathered more tightly than usual, and one pet became uneasy after being nudged by the crowd. The senior coordinator moved in at once, asked staff to open a clearer path, and had a second handler guide the line back into order. Care was kept calm and gentle, with extra attention given to each animal so that no further stress built up. A brief review of the affected traveler's report was started after the pet was settled and the area was made safe. <<FACT F119>> The traveler was also shown the usual support path, and the case notes were added for follow-up. <<FACT F113>> Staff then checked the floor space, adjusted the queue markers, and reminded the team to watch for bottlenecks at busy moments. The follow-up confirmed that the animal remained comfortable, the traveler felt heard, and the desk had returned to steady service. This incident closed with a simple reminder to keep routes clear and respond early.
